title: Serverless 256K–1M Qwen3p8 / Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-IQ3_S + Vision (optional Coder variant, llama.cpp, auto model cache)
description: Serverless worker adapted from llama-cpp-runpod for Qwen3.8/Qwen3p8 Flash-Next (IQ3_S), with a vision-enabled 256K–1M token long context. Includes presets for the base model and an optional Coder variant. You can also point it at other trimmed GGUF repos by changing LLAMA_ARG_HF_REPO and MMPROJ_HF_FILE.

input.name: Model (Hugging Face GGUF repo)
input.description: GGUF model repository to serve, e.g. ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-GGUF. Downloads on cold start unless the cached-model options below resolve a cached path first.

input.name: Quantization (tag)
input.description: Quantization tag selecting the GGUF file inside the repo (case-insensitive). Leave empty to use the repo default. Ignored if 'GGUF File in Repo' is set.

input.name: GGUF File in Repo (exact path)
input.description: Exact GGUF path inside the repo. Use this for sharded models (e.g. *-00001-of-00002.gguf) or files stored in subfolders. For sharded GGUF, set this to the FIRST shard (00001-of-00002).

input.name: MMProj file in Repo (vision)
input.description: Path to the mmproj file inside the model repo (vision). Example: mmproj-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-BF16.gguf. This worker resolves it from the HF cache and sets LLAMA_ARG_MMPROJ automatically.

input.name: Hugging Face Token
input.description: Access token for gated/private model repos. Leave empty for public models. The worker maps HF_TOKEN to HUGGINGFACE_HUB_TOKEN internally.

input.name: HF_HOME (persistent HF cache root)
input.description: Set to /runpod-volume/huggingface-cache to persist Hugging Face downloads on the mounted /runpod-volume. This prevents re-downloading on every cold start when /runpod-volume is attached.

input.name: Cached Model (optional)
input.description: Optional: HF repo id to resolve from the HF cache. If set (with Cached GGUF Path), the worker tries to load from cache first and falls back to downloading if missing. Recommended when using /runpod-volume caching.

input.name: Cached Model GGUF Path (optional)
input.description: Optional: Path to GGUF inside the cached repo. Required if Cached Model is set. For sharded GGUF, use the FIRST shard (00001-of-00002).

input.name: Context Size (total across slots)
input.description: Total context window in tokens. IMPORTANT: shared across Parallel Slots. Per-slot context is roughly Context Size / Parallel Slots. Example: ctx=1310720 and slots=5 gives ~262144 tokens (~256k) per slot.

input.name: Parallel Slots
input.description: Number of requests served simultaneously per worker. For long context, keep MAX_CONCURRENCY equal to this value to avoid piling multiple jobs behind one llama-server instance.

input.name: Max Concurrency per Worker
input.description: Maximum RunPod jobs accepted concurrently per worker. Recommended: set equal to Parallel Slots (LLAMA_ARG_N_PARALLEL).

input.name: GPU Layers
input.description: Number of model layers to offload to the GPU. 999 = all layers. Lower only if the model does not fit in VRAM.

input.name: Flash Attention
input.description: Enable Flash Attention (recommended).

input.name: KV Cache Type (K)
input.description: KV cache quantization. q8_0 is a good default. q4_0 uses less VRAM with more quality loss and can enable higher context/concurrency before OOM.

input.name: KV Cache Type (V)
input.description: KV cache quantization (V).

input.name: Logical Batch Size (-b)
input.description: Logical batch size. Rarely needs changing.

input.name: Physical Batch Size (-ub)
input.description: Physical batch size per device. Higher values can speed up prompt ingestion but increase peak memory use. If you see OOM during prompt/prefill, lower this first.

input.name: Extra llama-server Arguments
input.description: Additional command-line arguments passed verbatim to llama-server. Do not set --port. Recommended: -lm mmap --lazy-mode on

input.name: Enable metrics (/metrics)
input.description: If enabled, starts llama-server with --metrics to expose Prometheus metrics from inside the worker.

input.name: Metrics port
input.description: Port used by llama-server metrics when enabled (passed via --metrics-port if supported; otherwise used for scraping/pushing configuration).

input.name: Pushgateway URL (optional)
input.description: If set, the worker will push metrics to this Prometheus Pushgateway URL (e.g. http://your-host:9091). Leave empty to disable pushing.

input.name: Pushgateway job label
input.description: Prometheus job label used when pushing to Pushgateway.

input.name: Push interval (seconds)
input.description: How often to push metrics to Pushgateway while the worker is running (only when PUSHGATEWAY_URL is set).
